name: codeloud-family
description: CodeLoud product family monorepo: Voice, Relay, Web, Shared.

scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix Web run build
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix Web run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:relay && npm run typecheck:voice && npm run check:web
scripts.build: npm run build:relay && npm run build:voice && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:relay && npm run test:voice:unit && npm run test:web
